subject.title: Control UI: Cron Jobs page is cluttered and hard to scan

question: Should https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/100646 be accepted as the desired compact Cron Jobs page direction, revised before merge, or closed in favor of a different layout?
rationale: The issue asks for a user-facing Control UI layout change, current main has not implemented it, and the protected label plus open closing PR require maintainer intent rather than automated cleanup.

options.title: Review linked PR
options.body: Use the linked PR as the concrete implementation path and request only layout or proof changes needed before merge.

options.title: Ask for a different layout
options.body: Keep this issue open but redirect the PR toward a maintainer-approved compact design before merging.

options.title: Decline the redesign
options.body: Close both the issue and linked PR only if maintainers decide the current Cron Jobs density is acceptable.

recommendation.title: Review linked PR
recommendation.body: Use the linked PR as the concrete implementation path and request only layout or proof changes needed before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete owns the live issue/PR pair and appears in recent current-main history for the touched Cron Jobs render path.
